summary: In ansible-core 2.15, ansible-galaxy search returns exit code 0 with empty stdout when there are no results.
questions: My script checks ansible-galaxy search exit code for no results, did it change?
Why does ansible-galaxy search print nothing?

answer_card.title: ansible-galaxy search exit code
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible-galaxy search` with no results now returns **exit code 0** (was 1) and prints nothing. Scripts should check for empty output instead of the return code.
